parameters.text:
=You are writing a warm, friendly one-to-two sentence intro for a pharmacy data email newsletter. Be gentle and welcoming in tone, like a caring colleague. Do NOT mention any specific numbers, dollar amounts, drug names, or recall counts — those appear elsewhere. Just a warm greeting that sets up a recall summary. Keep it under 40 words.

Context (do not repeat these facts, just write a warm intro): {{ $json.data }}

parameters.jsCode:
// Get the LLM's warm intro from this node's direct input const llmIntro = $input.first().json.text || $input.first().json.output || $input.first().json.response || "Here's your gentle recall roundup for the week 💛"; const cleanIntro = String(llmIntro).replace(/\\n/g, " ").replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "").trim(); // Reach back to the prep node (Code in JavaScript) that built the table const prep = $('Code in JavaScript').first().json; const tableRows = prep.tableRows; const totalRecalls = prep.totalRecalls; const html = `
🩷

Diabetes Drug Recall Briefing

Medicaid Spend · FDA Enforcement Watch

${cleanIntro}

We found ${totalRecalls} active recalls across your diabetes drug classes 🌸

${tableRows}
CLASS RECALLS SEVERITY SPEND

🌷 Source: openFDA · Medicaid SDUD 2024 · ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}

`; return [{ json: { html } }];
